$comment: Crew-loop knobs (PLAN.md tooling item; system review 2026-10-13, flaw 7: rulings change the loop's behaviour through this file, never by editing the template). launch.mjs merges defaults with one crew's entry (objects merge one level deep; arrays replace), embeds the result and the crew's spec in the launched script, and refuses a crew marked draft. A ruling that changes a knob lands here through an orchestrator PR; prior-from-journal.cjs --refresh carries it into the next continuation. The mustFix quotes are word for word (crew-loop.check.cjs compares them with their sources).

mustFix.ruling: Owner decisions 2026-10-27 (system review, portfolio-evidence/loop-audit/SYSTEM-REVIEW-2026-10-13.md): website-first is reaffirmed (the Manor/project ion stays paused until the portfolio is live). The review's lean pre-launch crew model is ADOPTED for W-S2 onward: pre-launch must-fix taxonomy (block on acceptance-row failures, regressions vs main on default visitor paths, reproduced budget breaches, and slice design rows below target; pre-existing, rare-edge and tooling items go here by default); timed perf once per PR at the approval candidate plus once before G3a; 1 breaker pass by default (2 for W-F-m3); a design/motion jury with must-fix power on slices; waits of 270 s or less; a small versioned spec per crew. W-S2 cap: 3 code rounds plus 1 evidence round. No budget pause; each round still reports its cost. Slot 2's tooling PR now implements the review's quick wins before W-S2 launches.
